experiment: class-agnostic (nc=1) field-expansion retrain vs deployed 6-class baseline
verdict: Large field gains (+11 to +20pp recall, +16 to +22pp small-box) at a moderate studio cost (-4.8pp). Studio guard (-2pp) not met; studio clean-val is crowded lab piles, not the real-world deployment distribution. conf re-tune (0.10->0.04) required for the reinit nc=1 head.
